title: ZatsuTabi -That's Journey-
synopsis:
When aspiring manga artist Chika’s storyboards get rejected, she ditches her desk for an adventure! Armed with a quirky social media poll, she sets off on a spontaneous journey of random crowdsourced destinations. From hilarious mishaps to heartwarming encounters, Chika discovers inspiration, friendship, and herself, one unpredictable stop at a time.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: Based on the real life travels of mangaka Chika Suzugamori.

episodes.title: The First 1,225 Steps
episodes.synopsis:
Manga artist Suzugamori Chika goes on a journey guided by poll results. Her first destination: Aizuwakamatsu.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Real Deal! A Lively Journey for Two
episodes.synopsis:
Chika visits Matsushima alone and feels a little lonely. Koyomi joins her journey to Kurobe in Toyama.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Perfect the Way It Is
episodes.synopsis:
Chika and her junior Yui go on their first journey together to Takamatsu, Kagawa, in the Shikoku region.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Smile by the Sea
episodes.synopsis:
Chika travels to Kyoto with manga artists Fuyune and Riri and gets inspired by their creative process.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Crows, Dragons, Soba, and a Remote Island
episodes.synopsis:
Chika journeys to Tochigi alone and then to Awashima with Koyomi.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: An Epic Midsummer Journey!
episodes.synopsis:
Chika's Awashima journey with Koyomi ends, and Yui joins for "The Epic Summer Journey: Tokyo Arc."

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: A City Where You Can Meet Gods? And Then...
episodes.synopsis:
Chika visits the Ise Shrine with Riri. Then, Yoshimoto sends her off on a night bus trip with Yui and Fuyune.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Three Girls, Cozy and Full of Laughs
episodes.synopsis:
Chika explores Hiroshima with Fuyune and Yui. She then produces a draft that gets approved by her editor.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Completion at the Hot Spring, Then the First Sunrise
episodes.synopsis:
Chika goes on a solo journey to Aomori and then to Wakayama to see the first sunrise of the year.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Home in My Heart
episodes.synopsis:
After Chika returns from her solo journey in Wakayama, Koyomi joins her for a journey to Hanamaki in Iwate.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: A Pilgrimage with Master
episodes.synopsis:
Chika visits Izumo-Taisha in Shimane with Fuyune, where she finds out that Fuyune and Riri had an argument.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: That's Journey
episodes.synopsis:
Riri makes a surprise appearance, inspiring Chika. Yoshimoto offers Chika a shot to get her one-off published.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
